narrativeProgression.description: The man shares an anecdote about finding common ground with people holding different political views on environmental issues.
He emphasizes the importance of clean water and the Great Lakes, highlighting shared values even among those with different political stances.
Woman 1 agrees, pointing out that water unites people on a fundamental level.
The man and Woman 2 affirm her statement. The man concludes by emphasizing the importance of holding polluters accountable and attracting businesses that value environmental responsibility.
